summary.text: Sydney Carlin is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 66 who has represented the district since 2003 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Carlin is a former mayor of Manhattan, Kansas.

paragraphs.text: Sydney Carlin was born in Wichita, Kansas, attended Neosho County Community College and earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University.
She has worked as an office manager with the Manhattan Country Club and served as a city commissioner of Manhattan from 1993 to 1996 and as its mayor from 1996 to 1997.

Carlin has been a member of The Martin Luther King Committee, Daughters of the American Revolution, Daughters of the American Colonists, PEO, Konza Prairie Quilters Guild and the American Association of University Women, a charter member of the Fairy Godmothers Foundation, and co-founder of Manhattan Women 4 Kansas.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Taxation and Veterans and Military committees and is the ranking minority member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget Committee.
She faces Republican Noah Perry and Libertarian Andrew Frey in the general election.
